# Travel and Expense Policy

## 4.2 Approval thresholds

Claims of 75 pounds or more require line-manager approval before reimbursement.
A claim of exactly 75 pounds requires approval.

## 6.2 Accommodation caps

London is capped at 250 pounds per night, inclusive of taxes.
